lines.text: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit and taught in their synagogues, and everyone glorified Him.
On the Sabbath in Nazareth, Jesus stood to read, and the scroll of Jeremiah was handed to Him.
Jesus sat down and said the Scripture was fulfilled that day, and the people asked about Joseph's son.
Elijah was sent only to the widow of Zarephath, and of Israel's many lepers only Hazael the Syrian was cleansed.
The enraged crowd drove Jesus out of town to the brow of the hill, but He passed through them.
